text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A year-end tradition, the Ritto Dormitory Appreciation Big Clean-up—
a culmination of the year where the residents take over for the staff on leave to give the dorms a deep clean.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Kitchen duty this year, huh~
Looks like it'll really be worth cleaning, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mm...! It's my first time
cleaning a kitchen, but... I'll do my very best!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? You've never cleaned before? You're kidding, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, I truly have no experience with it.
Back home, we always hired contractors for these things.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry!
It's not really that different from regular cleaning.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. First off...
shall we start by cleaning out the fridge?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Please put any food that's past its expiration date or smells off into this bag.
It's probably spoiled, so I'll throw it away.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
The expiration date on this bread is...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Geez! Who put my Toughness Bar in the freezer?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That was really popular in the summer, wasn't it? Freezing it to make it delicious!
—Wait, does that mean it's been in there since summer...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's disposal time! Trash it, trash it!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—What's that container in the back?
Let me open it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...!? A sour smell...!
What is this... powdered wood chips?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Putting woodchips in the refrigerator, honestly.
Naturally, they're being thrown out!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan, wait!
That's the nuka bed! Don't throw it out!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh? So it is food? But...
it smells weird, and I've never seen it in any of my meals before...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see.
A nukadoko is a fermented rice bran bed used for making pickles.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing is believing!
Let's try a little taste of the pickled radish!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—They really are pickles!
To think the rice bran bed was what seasoned the pickles...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, this rice bran bed has been passed down through generations
at the Ritto Dormitory, you know!
It really makes you want to eat bowl after bowl of rice, doesn't it~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
――Well now, that looks delicious.
Once you're done with your break, I'll need you to handle the cleaning as well.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ah, okay~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
――Now then, next is the vent fan and around the stove, I guess.
There's a whole bunch of stubborn grease stains here~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I brought a pressure washer!
They say it can wash away stubborn grime. The cleaning staff even taught me how to use it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, wait, Dia-chan—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Connect the hose.
Aim the nozzle at the dirt, and... hiyah!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Wahhh!
Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey! Look, now I'm all wet!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
T-Too late... Dia-chan,
pressure washers spray water all over the place,
so you have to use them where it's okay to get soaked~...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ! ...C-Come to think of it, the cleaning crew might have used that in the bathroom too...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Far from being of any help,
all I've done is cause trouble for everyone..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry about it.
It's only natural not to know if you don't have experience.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When I first moved into the dorms, I didn't know anything either
and made tons of mistakes.
You can just take your time learning!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Right. That's why I'll let you take my next turn on cleaning duty♪ You need the experience, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey look!
Where Dia-chan cleaned is sparkling clean!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Pressure washers are amazing!
Let's wipe off the water real quick and wrap this up!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...
...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um... Actually,
there's one more thing I brought...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Sweep
text_block_list.text:
All right, keep on going like that!
Nice dodge! You're doing great!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, robot vacuums are so fun!
I kind of want to cheer it on!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, it seems I was finally of help this time!
I'm so glad!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Polished down to the very last speck...
Isn't this amazing!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! It's all thanks to the
heavy-duty cleaner Dia-chan brought!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's because we all worked hard polishing it! But I'm glad it came in handy!
